title: replace_image
description: Swap a picture for another image, keeping its place, size and alt text.

slide_id.description: The slide: its number in the deck (1 = first, as the deck map and the person say it) or its ID.

image.description: An image the person attached or uploaded (asset_id), or a picture of a knowledge-base document (kb_domain, kb_document, kb_image_id from kb_list_images). Never a URL.
